# Weekly Remote Team Productivity Snapshot

A compact view of output, collaboration load, backlog pressure, and delivery reliability across the four teams. The data suggests Support and Engineering are carrying the most throughput, while Engineering has the clearest bottleneck risk.

# Team Comparison and Dashboard Layout

## Productivity Comparison Table

| Team | Tasks Completed | Meetings Hours | Bugs Open | On-Time Delivery Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Design | 18 | 9 | 7 | 88% |
| Engineering | 31 | 14 | 12 | 79% |
| Marketing | 22 | 11 | 3 | 92% |
| Support | 40 | 8 | 5 | 95% |

## Tasks Completed Bar Chart Data

Use this as a horizontal bar chart or column chart in the dashboard.

| Team | Tasks Completed |
|---|---:|
| Support | 40 |
| Engineering | 31 |
| Marketing | 22 |
| Design | 18 |

## Delivery Rate Trend or Gauge Idea

For on-time delivery, a **gauge** works best for a quick executive read:
- **Support:** 95% — green, near target
- **Marketing:** 92% — green
- **Design:** 88% — amber
- **Engineering:** 79% — red, needs attention

If you prefer a trend view, use a **weekly line chart** for delivery rate by team with a target line at **90%**.

## Dashboard Layout Recommendation

### Top Row: Executive KPIs
- Total tasks completed
- Average delivery rate
- Total bugs open
- Total meeting hours

### Middle Row: Core Visuals
- Left: **Bar chart** for tasks completed by team
- Right: **Gauge chart** for on-time delivery rate by team, or a line chart with a 90% target line

### Bottom Row: Operational Detail
- Comparison table with all four metrics
- Bottleneck callouts highlighting teams below target or with high backlog

## Bottleneck Observations

- **Engineering is the main risk area:** it has strong output, but also the highest meeting load, the most bugs open, and the lowest delivery rate at **79%**.
- **Design may be under delivery pressure:** tasks completed are the lowest, while meeting hours are relatively high and delivery is still below the stronger teams at **88%**.

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+layout+productivity+metrics
- Action: [Button: Chart Ideas] https://www.google.com/search?q=bar+chart+gauge+dashboard+metrics

## Sources

- Chart design patterns: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/dashboard-design/
- Data visualization guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization-tips
